categories.title: Service categories
categories.intro: The kinds of problem customers report, and how quickly we promise to respond and to fix each. Requests turn amber in the last quarter of their time and red once it runs out; the service team gets one alert for each.
categories.caption: Service categories and their promised times
categories.visitNote: For maintenance visits, the first response is confirming the visit with the customer, and the resolution time counts from the visit day.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.intro: Years of cover for each part of a system. Cover starts on the commissioning day and is recorded on the project when testing and commissioning is completed. A panel, inverter or battery with its own warranty years in Products keeps those years, as printed on the quotation; these years are used when the product has none.

hints.panel: Product warranty, plus the maker’s power output (performance) warranty.
hints.workmanship: Our warranty on the installation work.

warranty.applies: Changes apply to systems commissioned from now on. Warranties already recorded keep their dates.
warranty.starter: These are the starting values; change them to match the makers you buy from.

amc.title: AMC plans
amc.intro: Annual maintenance contracts the service team can sell for a commissioned system. The visits are spread evenly across the contract; each opens as a service request a week ahead, and the customer gets a WhatsApp.
amc.caption: AMC plans
amc.emptyBody: Add a plan with its price, visits a year and what each visit includes.
